events.title: beta.14
events.summary: Town building, Onboarding, Quest Log and Guide update, bug fixes Your town got a lot more to play with: a new build menu and 47 decorations. New Adventures mode also gets the new "Order of the Red Church" Cathedral building including upgrades to your red priestesses. We've also tried to further improve the onboarding and help for new players by changing the start quest and how you gather your raiders. Besides that we polished some tips and added a new "Guide" window that explains core mechanics

events.summary: Game mode split, smarter snapshots, QoL, bug fixes Hello all you idleing folks! With this update we officially cut the game into 2 modes so people who want to simply enjoy the old Idle raiders: Second Run with a few improvements can do so in "Legacy mode", while everyone wanting balance changes, new content and features can decide (anytime) to play New Adventures mode, which is the one currently being "in development"! events.title: Idle Raiders: Second Run demo is now available!
events.summary: Hello and welcome to all you Idle Raiders or those who plan to maybe become one! We are happy to announce that you can now play the Idle Raiders: Second Run Demo on Steam! It contains the whole game so far, the only thing cut are the Raids: You can't go further than raid 6 (Chamber of the Sealer).
